findings: resizePage flattens all nonanalysis items and partitions into new fixed-size pages, discarding original query-group boundaries. New firstitem may not be original needle. Display pages must not be interpreted as newly verified all-pairs duplicate groups.

recordMatch assumes group[0] needle and positive candidate indexed1 or current item, writes matches.csv in Latin1 with raw quoted paths but no escaping quotes/newlines; negative row path unquoted. Unicode or delimiter-bearing paths can corrupt dataset evidence; no file written.

templateMatchAction reduces group to chosenpair and sets tmThresh64 deliberately to retain possible transforms for human evaluation. This is much looser than earlier testtmThresh7 and not verified match acceptance.

qualityScoreAction owns/deletes underlying io then creates QBuffer passed to ownership-taking EstimateJpegQuality, resolving that caller ownership question. It buffers full encoded input and only exposes JPEG estimate when jq.ok/reliable; no new source fidelity proof.

VideoCompareWidget created with _options reference owned by parent groupwidget but new comparison window not parented to groupwidget; closing originating viewer before comparison needs lifetime validation. No UI/use-after-lifetime runtime.

moveSelectionSorted renames then moves without rollback, calls updateMedia with constructed destination rather than pre-rename path, so other copies of oldpath in pages may stay stale. No filesystem operation executed.

Folder locks checked on several delete/move branches, but renameFile/copyName/moveDatabaseDir do not show equivalent checks in those methods. These locks are UI policy, not global immutable file protection. No bypass action performed.
browseParent selects path+percent without escaping wildcard characters/separator boundary. Result may include similarly prefixed directories; raw source scope, not actual SQL query executed.

updateItems colors metrics relative to first file; percent calculation lacks zero guard before some conversions. Such colors are comparisons, not verified original-quality preference. Analysis item flags disabled, avoiding ordinary selection of analysis rows.

deletePage retains page objects until widget destruction to avoid loader dangling references. Completed pages can accumulate book-keeping; checkMemoryUsage counts image payload only, not entire heap. No leak/throughput measurement.
